Animal Rescue Center is currently undergoing a comprehensive content update.

Our channel is now in a transition phase focused on quality over quantity. During this period, we are refining our creative process, reducing repetitive formats, and restructuring our storytelling approach to ensure clearer context, stronger educational value, and full policy compliance.

Going forward, Animal Rescue Station will:
• Clearly disclose AI-assisted or fictional elements where applicable
• Avoid sensational or misleading narratives
• Focus on responsible animal welfare, prevention, and ethical awareness
• Create more original, thoughtfully structured content with clear purpose

This update is part of our commitment to building a more transparent, meaningful, and sustainable channel. We appreciate the patience and understanding of viewers and the YouTube review team as we work to deliver better content moving forward.
